correctness.rationale: The input is a mixture of two product states and has Xu's Eq. (12) form in the normalized independent Alice basis {|0⟩,|u⟩}. The different operation basis has dual rows (1,−4/3) and (0,5/3), which give the stated rank-one operators. Direct rational multiplication gives the unnormalized second Alice block σ with trace 1769/2601, normalization Z=659/867 and output second-block probability 1769/2636. For a state classical on Bob, I is the entropy of the Alice marginal minus the average Alice conditional entropy, since the entropy of the Bob weights cancels. Both input conditionals and the first output conditional are pure; the stated three trace-one discriminants therefore give the displayed entropy calculation. Independent rational interval reproduction (independent_check.py) reconstructed the matrices and enclosures using integer square roots and explicit bounds on the atanh-series tail, establishing 1/30<Δ_nats<1/20. A separate high-precision evaluation of the entropy formula gives Δ=0.05728010640002332764… bits; decimals are not the strict certificate. The finite example proves the Eq. (21) infimum is negative and refutes universal Eq. (22). A one-dimensional subsystem gives I=0 throughout, so 2×2 is the smallest dimension in which this violation can occur. The sum effect has eigenvalues 5 and 5/9, so dividing the Kraus operators by sqrt(5) gives a physical success branch; its conditioning, not deterministic channel evolution, is decisive. Frozen code inspected, not executed.
